es.summary: El psilio es un laxante formador de masa que absorbe agua en el colon y aumenta el volumen fecal para facilitar la evacuación.
key_points: Se administra con al menos 150‑250 mL de agua por dosis.
Contraindicado en obstrucción intestinal y galactosemia.
Puede interferir con la absorción de otros fármacos si se toma simultáneamente.

mechanism: Absorbe agua y forma un gel viscoso que aumenta la masa fecal.
Incrementa la presión luminal y estimula la peristalsis colónica.
Favorece la hidratación de la mucosa y la regularidad intestinal.
indications: Prevención de hemorroides y fisuras anales.
Control de colesterol y mejora de la salud cardiovascular.
contraindications: Hipersensibilidad al psyllium o a la lactosa contenida.
Galactosemia, deficiencia de lactasa o malabsorción de glucosa‑galactosa.
interactions: Reduce absorción de algunos fármacos (ej. carbamazepina, digoxina) si se toma <1 h antes o después.
Puede disminuir la eficacia de antibióticos orales.
Aumenta la absorción de glucosa y colesterol cuando se combina con dietas altas en fibra.
nursing_care: Evaluar patrón de evacuación y consistencia de heces antes de administrar.
Asegurar ingesta de al menos 150‑250 mL de agua con cada dosis.
Observar signos de distensión abdominal, náuseas o vómitos; suspender y notificar si aparecen.
Monitorear electrolitos si el paciente usa laxantes crónicamente.
Documentar número y tipo de deposiciones diarias.
patient_teaching: Tomar el psilio con un vaso lleno de agua (≈240 mL) y seguir con suficiente líquido durante el día.
No tomar antes de acostarse sin agua para evitar obstrucción.
Incrementar la ingesta de fibra y líquidos gradualmente para evitar gases.
Reportar dolor abdominal intenso, ausencia de evacuación >3 días o sangre en heces.

care_plans.diagnosis: Riesgo de desequilibrio de volumen de líquidos
related_to: Ingesta insuficiente de agua con laxante
Uso de laxantes sin hidratación adecuada
outcomes: Hidratación adecuada: ingesta ≥2 L de agua/día en 48 h.
Eliminación intestinal regular: 3‑4 deposiciones blandas/semana en 5 días.

interventions.action: Verificar que el paciente tome el psilio con al menos 150 mL de agua por dosis.
Registrar ingesta de líquidos y salida de orina cada 8 h.
interventions.rationale: Permite detectar déficit de volumen temprano.

interventions.action: Evaluar la consistencia y frecuencia de las heces cada turno.
interventions.rationale: Identifica respuesta al tratamiento y riesgo de diarrea.

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre la importancia de mantener hidratación adecuada mientras usa laxantes.
interventions.rationale: Reduce el riesgo de desequilibrio hídrico.

interventions.action: Notificar al médico si aparecen signos de deshidratación (sed intensa, piel seca, hipotensión).

en.summary: Psyllium is a bulk-forming laxative that absorbs water in the colon and increases stool volume to facilitate evacuation.
key_points: Administer with at least 150‑250 mL of water per dose.
Contraindicated in intestinal obstruction and galactosemia.
May interfere with absorption of other drugs if taken simultaneously.

mechanism: Absorbs water and forms a viscous gel that increases stool mass.
Increases luminal pressure and stimulates colonic peristalsis.
Promotes mucosal hydration and intestinal regularity.
indications: Prevention of hemorrhoids and anal fissures.
Cholesterol control and improvement of cardiovascular health.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to psyllium or contained lactose.
Galactosemia, lactase deficiency or glucose‑galactose malabsorption.
interactions: Reduces absorption of some drugs (e.g., carbamazepine, digoxin) if taken <1 h before or after.
May decrease efficacy of oral antibiotics.
Increases absorption of glucose and cholesterol when combined with high‑fiber diets.
nursing_care: Assess bowel pattern and stool consistency before administration.
Ensure intake of at least 150‑250 mL of water with each dose.
Observe for abdominal distension, nausea, or vomiting; discontinue and notify if they occur.
Monitor electrolytes if patient uses chronic laxatives.
Document number and type of daily stools.
patient_teaching: Take psyllium with a full glass of water (≈240 mL) and continue with adequate fluids throughout the day.
Do not take before bedtime without water to avoid obstruction.
Increase fiber and fluid intake gradually to avoid gas.
Report severe abdominal pain, absence of evacuation >3 days, or blood in stool.

related_to: Use of laxatives without adequate hydration
outcomes: Adequate hydration: intake ≥2 L of water/day within 48 h.
Regular bowel elimination: 3‑4 soft stools/week within 5 days.

interventions.action: Verify that the patient takes psyllium with at least 150 mL of water per dose.
Record fluid intake and urine output every 8 h.
interventions.rationale: Allows early detection of volume deficit.

interventions.action: Assess stool consistency and frequency each shift.
interventions.rationale: Identifies response to treatment and risk of diarrhea.

interventions.action: Educate the patient on the importance of maintaining adequate hydration while using laxatives.
Notify the physician if signs of dehydration appear (intense thirst, dry skin, hypotension).

summary.0.quote: Psyllium is an oral bulk-producing laxative that promotes natural elimination by absorbing water into its soluble fiber, softening feces and increasing stool bulk.

sections.mechanism.0.quote: Psyllium is an oral bulk-producing laxative that promotes natural elimination by absorbing water into its soluble fiber, softening feces and increasing stool bulk.

sections.mechanism.2.quote: Calcium polycarbophil restores a balanced moisture level in the colon to form solid soft stool in cases of constipation or diarrhea.

sections.indications.0.quote: It is considered safe and can help with occasional and chronic constipation relief.

sections.indications.1.quote: Stool softeners are particularly useful for individuals who need to avoid straining caused by medical conditions (e.g., hemorrhoids, anal fissures) or after certain surgeries.

sections.indications.2.quote: Psyllium supports digestive health, helps to maintain healthy glycemic control, promotes a healthy heart with cholesterol reduction, and promotes a healthy weight by reducing hunger (Proctor & Gamble, 2022).

sections.contraindications.0.quote: Bulk-forming laxatives should not be used in clients with symptoms of acute appendicitis, esophageal stricture or perforation, GI obstruction, or ileus.

sections.adverse_effects.0.quote: The accumulation of stool in the colon can also lead to distension, gas, and bloating (sensation of fullness or swelling in the abdomen), contributing to abdominal discomfort.

sections.nursing_care.0.quote: Assess client’s bowel habits including frequency, consistency, and ease of bowel movements.

sections.nursing_care.1.quote: Available in tablet and chewable forms, it should be taken with at least 8 ounces of water or juice to prevent choking and ensure its effectiveness.
